title: CertificationScopeRow
description: One row of portfolio/CERTIFICATION_SCOPE.csv (docs/architecture/RUNTIME_IDENTITY_COVERAGE_CONTRACT_20260905.md). Keyed exact account|magic. This is a standalone schema file rather than an addition to _triage/factory_os/schemas.json's DESIGN_ONLY discriminated-union root, so that adding it carries no risk of widening any existing closed (unevaluatedProperties:false) entity there.

identity_mechanism_capability.description: UNKNOWN is fail-closed and must never be interpreted as excluded or capable by default. NO_NATIVE_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_MT4 may be transcribed only when the row's platform is proven MT4 in portfolio/DEPLOYMENTS.csv.

identity_certification_scope.description: UNKNOWN is fail-closed. USER_OWNED_UNCERTIFIED may be transcribed only from an explicit self-declared certification-scope statement for that exact row, never inferred from trade history, filenames, account-level prose, or dashboard presence, and never from a note that merely MENTIONS another row's certification fact.

evidence_ref.description: Human-readable pointer to the exact explicit fact this row transcribes (e.g. 'DEPLOYMENTS.csv platform=MT4' or 'DEPLOYMENTS.csv notes: literal "lab does not certify"'). Never a narrative verdict.

status.description: Row lifecycle marker for this scope owner (e.g. TRANSCRIBED). Independent of DEPLOYMENTS.csv's own status column.

x-enforced-by: certification_scope.py: parse_certification_scope_rows validates shape/enum/key-uniqueness; classify_forward_scope reconciles against the canonical forward-observed deployment universe
x-seed-tool: scripts/research/seed_certification_scope.py (one-time mechanical transcription; not a runtime dependency)
